healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Validate the BoldSign API key by reading remaining API credits.

documents.list.title: List documents
documents.list.description: List BoldSign documents with optional page and pageSize filters.

documents.get.description: Get BoldSign document details and status by documentId.

templates.list.title: List templates
templates.list.description: List BoldSign templates with optional page and pageSize filters.

templates.get.title: Get template
templates.get.description: Get BoldSign template details by templateId.

documents.send.title: Send document
documents.send.description: Send a BoldSign document for signature via POST /v1/document/send.

title.description: Document title shown in email and the BoldSign UI.

fileUrl.description: Public URL of the file to send.

documents.remind.title: Remind signers
documents.remind.description: Send a BoldSign reminder via POST /v1/document/remind.

documents.revoke.title: Revoke document
documents.revoke.description: Revoke a BoldSign signature request via POST /v1/document/revoke.

documents.delete.title: Delete document
documents.delete.description: Delete a BoldSign document via DELETE /v1/document/delete.

documents.team.list.title: List team documents
documents.team.list.description: List BoldSign team documents via GET /v1/document/teamlist.

templates.delete.title: Delete template
templates.delete.description: Delete a BoldSign template via DELETE /v1/template/delete.

contacts.get.title: Get contact
contacts.get.description: Get one BoldSign contact via GET /v1/contacts/get.

contacts.create.title: Create contact
contacts.create.description: Create a BoldSign contact via POST /v1/contacts/create.

contacts.delete.title: Delete contact
contacts.delete.description: Delete a BoldSign contact via DELETE /v1/contacts/delete.

brands.get.title: Get brand
brands.get.description: Get one BoldSign brand via GET /v1/brand/getbrand.

senderIdentities.list.title: List sender identities
senderIdentities.list.description: List BoldSign sender identities via GET /v1/senderIdentities/list.

brands.getDetails.title: Get brand details
brands.getDetails.description: Get one BoldSign brand via GET /v1/brand/get. Does not replace brands.get (GET /v1/brand/getbrand).

customFields.create.title: Create custom field
customFields.create.description: Create a BoldSign custom field via POST /v1/customField/create.

brandId.description: Brand the custom field belongs to.

sharedField.description: Whether the field is shared in the organization.

fieldType.description: Form field type, such as Signature or TextBox.

width.description: Field width. Must be greater than zero.

height.description: Field height. Must be greater than zero.

isRequired.description: Whether the signer must fill the field.

isMasked.description: Whether the value is hidden from other signers.

value.description: Value shown on a label field.

font.description: Font family: Courier, Helvetica, or TimesNewRoman.

fontHexColor.description: Font color as a hex code.

characterLimit.description: Maximum characters. Must be greater than zero.

placeHolder.description: Hint text for a text box.

validationType.description: Text box validation, such as None, NumbersOnly, Regex, Currency, or Email.

resizeOption.description: GrowHorizontally, GrowVertically, GrowBoth, FixedSize, or AutoResizeFont.

customFields.edit.title: Edit custom field
customFields.edit.description: Edit a BoldSign custom field via POST /v1/customField/edit.

brandId.description: Brand the custom field belongs to.

sharedField.description: Whether the field is shared in the organization.

fieldType.description: Form field type, such as Signature or TextBox.

width.description: Field width. Must be greater than zero.

height.description: Field height. Must be greater than zero.

isRequired.description: Whether the signer must fill the field.

isMasked.description: Whether the value is hidden from other signers.

value.description: Value shown on a label field.

font.description: Font family: Courier, Helvetica, or TimesNewRoman.

fontHexColor.description: Font color as a hex code.

characterLimit.description: Maximum characters. Must be greater than zero.

placeHolder.description: Hint text for a text box.

validationType.description: Text box validation, such as None, NumbersOnly, Regex, Currency, or Email.

resizeOption.description: GrowHorizontally, GrowVertically, GrowBoth, FixedSize, or AutoResizeFont.

documents.behalfList.title: List behalf documents
documents.behalfList.description: List BoldSign documents sent on behalf of a sender identity via GET /v1/document/behalfList.

pageSize.description: Documents per page. Defaults to 10. Maximum is 100.

pageType.description: BehalfOfOthers or BehalfOfMe. Defaults to BehalfOfOthers.

signers.description: Signer email addresses to filter by.

emailAddress.description: Sender-identity email addresses to filter by.

searchKey.description: Keyword matched against title, id, and names.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the last document, for results past 10,000.

documents.edit.title: Edit document
documents.edit.description: Edit a BoldSign document via PUT /v1/document/edit. Partial JSON updates only; file upload is omitted. A request without files returns status Completed.

signers.description: Signers to add, update, or remove. Objects use the documented JSON keys, including EditAction.

cc.description: CC recipients. Each object uses EmailAddress.

scheduledSendTime.description: Unix timestamp for a draft send.

documentTimeZone.description: IANA time zone, such as Asia/Kolkata.

embeddedRequests.createLink.title: Create embedded request link
embeddedRequests.createLink.description: Create a BoldSign embedded request URL via POST /v1/document/createEmbeddedRequestUrl using application/json. PDF and multipart file upload are omitted; pass public file URLs in fileUrls.

showToolbar.description: Show the editor toolbar. Defaults to false.

showNavigationButtons.description: Show the Back button. Defaults to true.

showSaveButton.description: Show Save and Close. Defaults to true.

sendViewOption.description: Initial embedded page. Defaults to PreparePage.

showTooltip.description: Show the prepare-page tooltip. Defaults to false.

sendLinkValidTill.description: Embedded URL expiry as a date-time. Maximum 180 days.

redirectUrl.description: Redirect URI after the request is prepared.

allowScheduledSend.description: Allow scheduling the send. Defaults to false.

signers.description: Signers using the documented JSON keys (Name, EmailAddress, SignerOrder, FormFields).

fileUrls.description: Public file URLs. Not a multipart or base64 PDF upload.
